pins.text: return { engineFilesystem: policy.tiers.has('files'), engineProcesses: policy.tiers.has('shell'), pipesHere: policy.tiers.has('pipes') };
pins.why: the engine's disk is the files tier's and its programs the shell tier's, from the policy alone
the daemon's surface takes the disk grant from the policy, never the attached surface
the daemon's surface takes the program grant from the policy, never the attached surface

pins.text: engineHost_grants(policy).pipesHere ? host(command, input, signal) : relay(command, input)
pins.why: a host pipeline runs here only with the pipes tier
a ! command runs here only with the shell tier
plugin add starts docker only when the session may start programs

pins.text: if ('refused' in docker) return addFailure_record(docker.refused, detected);
pins.why: no runner given, the image path refuses
the key file is on the engine's host
a checkout is a folder on the engine's host
a redirect writes the engine's host disk
a job (stratus's ssh, tofu, helm) starts only with the tasks tier
